sections.lede: Long-fermented sourdough, butter croissants and a short list of cakes, baked every morning and gone by noon. Pre-order on WhatsApp and we keep yours aside.
facts: Out of the oven by 6 am

front.alt: A round sourdough loaf on a board

sections.text: Two ovens, one long table and a starter older than the shop. Everything on the shelf is made here, from flour we buy by the sack.

sections.heading: What comes out of the oven.
sections.blurb: Three things we bake every day. The rest changes with the week.

items.title: Country sourdough
items.text: A dark crust and an open crumb, from a 48-hour ferment.

items.title: Butter croissant
items.text: Laminated over three days, baked at first light.

items.title: Seed rye
items.text: Dense, sour and full of sunflower and flax.

steps.title: Message us
steps.text: Tell us what you want and when you will collect.

steps.title: We bake it
steps.text: Your order goes into the first bake of the day.

steps.title: Collect
steps.text: It waits at the counter with your name on it.

sections.heading: Simple prices.
sections.note: Prices per item. Larger orders for events by arrangement.

sections.heading: Stone-milled, unbleached, nothing added.
sections.blurb: Our bread is flour, water and salt. The time does the rest.

sections.heading: Come early.
sections.blurb: Tuesday to Sunday from 6 am until we sell out.
